description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Synergetics is hiring a software engineer for OpenFLIS, which supports federal logistics teams in finding and working with data. The role builds C#/.NET services and APIs, automates deployment and operations, and helps improve the product’s reliability in Azure Government.
Software Engineer building C#/.NET cloud platform features and APIs, automating operations, and improving CI/CD and infrastructure as code

Responsibilities:
• Build, test, and maintain features and APIs, primarily in C#/.NET, with opportunities to work in Angular and SQL
• Turn repetitive operational work into code: automate data-load checks, improve alerts, and make deployments easier to repeat and troubleshoot
• Use logs, metrics, and tests to track down failures, then fix the underlying issue and document what you learned
• Improve continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, contribute to infrastructure as code, and follow the team’s secure development and change-control practices

Requirements:
• Hands-on experience building and debugging software, ideally in C#/.NET or a comparable backend stack
• Show us something you built or improved through work, an internship, coursework, open source, or an independent project
• Working knowledge of Git, APIs, and relational databases, plus enough familiarity with testing to verify your own changes
• Curiosity about how software is deployed and operated
• You take initiative, ask for help when you need it, and follow through on a fix

Preferred:
• Experience with Azure or another cloud, GitHub Actions, Angular or TypeScript, containers, or infrastructure as code is helpful
